_comment: Reference copy of the live daily routine (trig_011WCaBkju3UMBApJV2QZ2W6). Manage at https://claude.ai/code/routines/trig_011WCaBkju3UMBApJV2QZ2W6. Editing this file does NOT change the live routine — it must be pushed via the RemoteTrigger API.
_dst_note: Cron is fixed UTC and cannot follow daylight saving, so this fires TWICE daily — 14:00 and 15:00 UTC. Exactly one of those is 10:00 in America/Toronto year-round (14:00 UTC during EDT, 15:00 UTC during EST). STEP 0 checks the local hour and no-ops the other firing. Do not remove an hour without also removing the guard.
_prompt_note: The prompt deliberately defers to .claude/agents/news-dashboard.md and actuarial-ds-news-dashboard-instructions.md, which change often. The inline restatement is a safety net for the mistakes that have actually happened (overwrite instead of merge, missing item_type, deep reads instead of headline-first). When the spec changes materially, update this prompt too — a stale prompt that contradicts the repo files is worse than a short one.
name: Daily Actuarial & DS News Dashboard (10am Toronto)

mcp_connections.name: Slack
mcp_connections._note: Slack only. The API attaches every connector on the account by default; Gmail/Drive/Linear/Granola were deliberately cleared — a news scraper has no business holding those credentials.

message.content: See the live routine for the authoritative prompt. Summary of its five steps: (0) DST guard — exit unless TZ=America/Toronto hour is 10, and send no Slack message when skipping; (1) read .claude/agents/news-dashboard.md and actuarial-ds-news-dashboard-instructions.md, which win over the prompt; (2) run — merge never overwrite, never reset seen.json, Actuarial 7-day window and Data Science 24-48h, headline-first 3-sentence summaries, item_type required on every item, commercial P&C filter on Actuarial, six commercial-lines trade feeds first with a curl fallback for Business Insurance, skip InsuranceERM; (3) commit and push, rebasing if rejected; (4) send exactly one short Slack DM to U0BGG3J1S8Y after a successful push, and none if the run skipped or failed, so a missing message signals breakage; (5) report new-item count separately from the total, plus per-source outcomes.
